label: Turned Hegelian dialectic from idealist spirit right side up into historical materialism
description: Karl Marx engaged in a direct critique of G.W.F. Hegel's foundational principles, rejecting core axioms in favor of a dialectically opposed framework.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from G.W.F. Hegel's perspective to Karl Marx's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the German Idealism & Romanticism across history into the 19th Century Divergences.

label: Formulated and introduced Dialectical Historical Reason
description: G.W.F. Hegel formulated and introduced the concept of "Dialectical Historical Reason", which became a seminal contribution in metaphysics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in metaphysics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the German Idealism & Romanticism as part of G.W.F. Hegel's canonical writings.

label: Master-Slave Dialectic & Alterity in The Second Sex
description: Simone de Beauvoir critically appropriated G.W.F. Hegel's Master-Slave dialectic in Phenomenology of Spirit to theorize woman as 'The Other' (L'Autre), demonstrating that unlike Hegel's historical dialectic where the bondsman achieves reciprocal recognition through labor, patriarchal social structures historically denied reciprocal revolt.
dialecticalTension: Adapting Hegel's universal dialectic of mutual recognition to diagnose asymmetrical gender subordination lacking reciprocal struggle.
historicalContext: Post-war French Hegelian renaissance influenced by Alexandre Kojève's Paris lectures on Phenomenology of Spirit.
